easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Yannik until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
